title: Archive through April 6, 2004 - Anonymous (Tuesday, March 30, 2004 - 09:55 pm)
content: I had visited your web site, and thought I would share my experience with death with you! In 1979, I was in an accident on a motorcycle that left me with major injuries. At that time, I was 20 years old. I had died just minutes after reaching the hospital. Things I remember are seeing myself being worked on to bring me back to life. I never saw the light that so many talk about. However, I did feel the peaceful feeling that comes with death. I have never talked about this experience to any except my wife and children. I have always known that there is something on that other side that I will visit one day. I am not afraid of death anymore. Well, years have went by since then; now I'm 40 years old, had a lot of family trouble, got divorced and so on. It took a toll on me bad. Well, in 1997, I was drinking one night. I got to thinking about my life and that I had lost my family! So I took a gun and without hesitation put it to my head and pulled the trigger. From that point, I had a visit from a lady; don’t know who it was to this day. She was not from real life. she had told me I am not suppose to be there, that what I had done is very wrong, and that she was going to make it right again. This I had not told anyone either. Then I spent the next two weeks in a nightmare kind of state, living with awful things. Unlike the first time I died, she told me if I ever take my life again, this is what I would have to live with for eternity. Then I woke up in the hospital. I have come close to dying many times in my life: from drowning to almost getting shot during a hunting season. But I always seem to have some angel watching over me all the time. Am I special? I don’t know, but to someone in the after life I suppose I am. What my reason is for living I don’t know. Why I dodge death so many times, I don’t know either. But I do know I won’t take my life again by my own hand. That nightmare is one I don’t want again. So now days, I try to understand god and things and to be a good person. In my belief, I think I am still here learning good things in life and treating and loving people. I have hate for no other person on earth, no matter what they have done against me. That is my belief as of this day. Thank you and what great research you have done!!!

arrival.other_being_detail: In 1997 he reports a visit from an unknown lady: “don’t know who it was to this day… She was not from real life.”

context.nde_cause_other_detail: 1979 motorcycle accident; later (1997) self-inflicted gunshot suicide attempt.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Reports a subsequent “nightmare kind of state” lasting two weeks after the 1997 suicide attempt.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: 1979: OBE of seeing resuscitation; no light reported. 1997: encounter with an unknown lady who said he was not supposed to be there, followed by two weeks of a nightmare-like state, then awakening in hospital.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: After the 1997 suicide attempt, he reports “the next two weeks in a nightmare kind of state, living with awful things,” and a warning that if he took his life again he would live with that “for eternity.”
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “seeing myself being worked on to bring me back to life.” “I never saw the light that so many talk about. However, I did feel the peaceful feeling that comes with death.” “she had told me I am not suppose to be there, that what I had done is very wrong, and that she was going to make it right again.” “if I ever take my life again, this is what I would have to live with for eternity.” “I am not afraid of death anymore.”
